title: Automated Multilingual Customer Support Routing
business: Global logistics companies managing high-volume, multilingual customer inquiries via phone.
problem: Manual call routing based on language selection is slow, prone to error, and increases wait times, leading to customer frustration.
solution: Azure AI Speech provides speech recognition to identify the caller's language in real-time, enabling automated, intelligent routing to the appropriate support queue without manual menu navigation.
steps: Provision an Azure AI Speech resource in the Azure portal.
Configure the Speech-to-Text service to enable continuous language identification.
Integrate the Speech SDK into the telephony gateway to stream audio input.
Implement logic to parse the identified language locale from the service response.
Route the call to the corresponding regional support agent pool based on the locale.
outcome: Reduced call abandonment rates and improved operational efficiency by eliminating manual language selection steps.
limitation: Language identification accuracy can degrade in environments with significant background noise or overlapping speech; verify performance by testing with representative audio samples.
